info.name: DAWWARHA — Resource API Collection
info.description: Postman API collection for DAWWARHA Resource Supply Endpoints (Engineer 2), including soft-cancellation via DELETE /api/resources/:id.

variable.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the resource to cancel

request.description: CRITICAL: This endpoint performs a SOFT CANCELLATION, NOT a hard delete. The resource document remains in MongoDB with status='cancelled'. Internally invokes resourceLifecycleService.transitionResource with action='cancel'. Allowed for resource owner or admin. Rejects completed/impact_recorded/already-cancelled resources with 409 Conflict.

response.name: 200 OK — Cancelled Successfully
409 Conflict — Already Cancelled / Terminal State
403 Forbidden — Non-Owner User
